_doc: Source registry for the harvester. kind: rss (feed items, each linked article captured) or html_list (a listing page; links matching link_pattern are captured). status: active; blocked_from_cloud (the site refuses requests from cloud egress, kept for a future fetch route or manual capture); needs_work (reachable but the parser does not yet find articles). cadence is advisory for the scheduler (ticket 07). Probe results are refreshed with `python -m pipeline.harvest probe`.
